_note: Draft Duel tuning. Times are in seconds, distances in tiles. The fighting itself is tuned in battle_rules.json. Starters: up to `starters` animals worth up to `starter_budget` Acorns. Training an animal up a star costs its card cost times its current stars, plus train_extra; each star after the first adds star_bonus_pct to health and bite. A round's loser loses heart_loss_per_round hearts for each round played so far, plus heart_loss_per_animal for each of the winner's animals still standing; a player who folds loses only the first part.

stakes.name: Safe
stakes.text: Half the trophies, win or lose.

stakes.name: All-in
stakes.text: Double the trophies, win or lose.
